changes_made.explanation: Added GPT-2 which was mentioned in experiments, normalized model names to standard forms (removed 'uncased' variant since all models are BERT-base variants), and standardized output descriptions
All automatic metrics were correctly extracted and already in canonical form

Removed incorrect items - the paper does NOT use LLMs as judges. BERT and RoBERTa are used as reading comprehension models for filtering, not as evaluators. Round-trip filtering is a computational method, not LLM-as-judge.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - the paper relies solely on automatic metrics for evaluation

overall_notes: The paper focuses on end-to-end QA data generation for domain adaptation, using automatic evaluation metrics (BLEU, EM, F1) to validate the quality of generated question-answer pairs. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methodology was employed. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for model names.
